name: Paneer Peshawari
steps: Soak cashews in 120 ml warm water for 15 minutes, then blend with their soaking water until completely smooth. Keep the remaining water for adjusting the gravy.
Melt ghee in a pan and fry cardamom and cinnamon briefly. Add onions and cook 7 minutes until golden; stir in ginger-garlic paste for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, coriander, chili and salt. Cook 10 minutes, stirring and crushing tomatoes, until the masala thickens. Remove cinnamon and blend the masala if a velvety texture is wanted.
Return masala to the pan, add cashew paste and remaining water. Simmer gently 5 minutes, stirring so the nuts do not catch. Add paneer and warm through for 4 minutes.
Switch off the heat, stir in cream and crushed kasuri methi, and scatter chopped pistachios over the top. Serve with roti or jeera rice.
tips: Keep the cashew sauce at a gentle simmer; vigorous boiling can make it grainy.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
